name: Ultimate Lemmix
subtitle: Small feet. Big problems.
promotionalText: Guide the Lemmix to safety. Start with three original puzzles, then bring your own compatible game data. Keep your journeys, replays and local Hot Seat games.
description:
The rescue quota has been approved. You may have other plans.

Guide a determined little crowd through pixel puzzles. Choose skills, plan a route and try to bring everyone home.

Ultimate Lemmix includes three authored starter puzzles, Lix characters, pixel lettering and stone controls. You can play the included puzzles without original game files or a hosted account.

Play your way:
• Pause, plan and rewind.
• Keep saved journeys, records and replays.
• Take turns locally with Hot Seat.
• Use hints and rescue targets where verified data is available.
• Choose HD effects and presentation options.
• Import supported levels or restore assets from your own collection.

Additional campaigns, original artwork and original soundtracks are not included. Compatible game-data import is optional. You must have the rights required to use the files you import. Some supported engines and content formats remain Beta.

Cloud-save and sharing features need a network connection. Community record sharing is optional. Local play remains available without it.

Mac and iPhone/iPad include Desk Clock and its widget. Apple TV includes Top Shelf. Input and effects adapt to each platform.
